findings.title: Focused homepage navigation versus broader public inventory
findings.evidence: Homepage source-HTML links resolve to four page URLs: home, case-study hub, privacy policy and terms. The sitemap lists 70 URLs, including 40 commercial-looking paths classified by URL pattern.

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

findings.businessImplication: The public service inventory is broader than the homepage navigation exposes. A focused conversion path may be intentional.

findings.title: Commercial discovery is worth a bounded validation
findings.evidence: No homepage-to-commercial-service path is present when traversal is restricted to the sampled HTML graph. Other site pages, rendering and external discovery can change the full picture.

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

findings.businessImplication: A selected service hub could help both interested visitors and crawlers discover the offering.
findings.recommendedAction: Confirm navigation intent and priority URLs; validate the full rendered graph before adding a restrained hub link. Do not declare all unlinked sample nodes orphaned.

findings.title: Service-to-proof relationships are already present
findings.evidence: Shopify agency and category-page service HTML link directly to /case-studies/sports-nutrition-brand and /case-studies/roofnest.

source.title: Shopify SEO Agency Built for AI Search | SEOasis | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

findings.businessImplication: Existing proof links support commercial evaluation; strengthen relevant relationships rather than add indiscriminate links.

findings.title: Supporting content already links to commercial pages
findings.evidence: The Shopify optimization guide links to /shopify-seo-company; the Reddit ecommerce guide links to /shopify-seo-consultant; the agency-selection guide links to /best-shopify-seo-agency.

source.title: How to Optimize Shopify Sites for Search Engines in 2026 | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

findings.businessImplication: Contextual reinforcement exists. Validate whether each destination best serves the article section and assigned intent.

findings.title: Reciprocal methodology and proof links offer a small test
findings.evidence: The Bronson AI case describes collection pages and hub-and-spoke linking, but its source HTML has no direct link to the category-page service. The Shopping case links to Bronson AI; the Bronson AI case does not link back to Shopping.

source.title: How SEOasis Unlocked AI Visibility for Bronson Vitamins | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

findings.businessImplication: Relevant links could help an evaluator move from proof to methodology or adjacent proof.
findings.recommendedAction: Add only where a useful sentence supports the relationship; no reciprocal-link quota or ranking guarantee.

orphanValidation.title: Full discovery and query ownership check
orphanValidation.evidence: The sample does not include all referring URLs, browser-rendered links, crawl logs or indexation data.

source.title: AI-Focused Shopify SEO Agency | SEOasis
source.note: Saved direct HTTP response and server-delivered HTML; no browser rendering or private performance data.

orphanValidation.platform: Google Search Console + approved complete crawl/export + server logs if available
orphanValidation.metric: Canonical URL inventory, internal inlinks, minimum depth, rendering differences, indexed/crawled state and query ownership.
orphanValidation.whyItMatters: A zero-inlink node in a purposive sample cannot establish a real orphan, and linked pages can still be unindexed.
orphanValidation.decision: Prioritize navigation/contextual-link changes; investigate verified orphans and mapping conflicts.

steps: Write a contextual anchor with the reader task in mind.
Check status, canonical, index policy and mobile path.
Record source/target and before/after evidence in Asana.
Review destination queries and qualified outcomes; revise at the quarterly review.
releaseWorkflow.doneDefinition: Useful live link passes QA, has an owner and has a scheduled measurement review; link count alone is not success.
